name: Sponsara
description: Sponsara helps brands, agencies, and creators price and review YouTube sponsorships before they commit. Ask Claude what a channel is worth using current performance data and niche CPM benchmarks, or compare a creator quote with Sponsara pricing to get a proceed, counter, or clarify recommendation and a reply draft. Claude can also find creators, campaigns, deals, and follow-ups in your Sponsara workspace. Connections start read-only, with optional workflow updates for managing private records. New users can start a 14-day Growth trial to try Sponsara in Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sponsara to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sponsara to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.sponsara.ai/functions/v1/mcp-server. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sponsara MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sponsara lists 18 MCP tools, including sponsara_add_creator_to_campaign, sponsara_add_deal_note, sponsara_create_campaign, sponsara_create_creator, sponsara_forecast_roi, sponsara_get_campaign, sponsara_get_campaign_roi, sponsara_get_creator, sponsara_get_creator_decision, sponsara_health_check, sponsara_list_campaigns, and sponsara_list_creators.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sponsara?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Sponsara in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Sponsara requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Sponsara is developed by Sponsara. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
